name: FCO: FlyConnectome Ontology (Play Pen working definition)
note: Working definition, not a published ontology. See docs/AGENT_CONNECTOR.md. Addresses are fcg:<type>/<slug>.

statuses.built: Exists and works in this project.
statuses.needed: Not built yet; nothing is blocking it.
statuses.blocked: Cannot start until something outside the project happens.
statuses.external: Already built elsewhere (for example by the fly community) and reused, not rebuilt.

nodeTypes.species: An organism with (or getting) a connectome.
nodeTypes.stage: A step of the connectome pipeline (imaging to public release).
nodeTypes.tool: An existing software package, platform or viewer (R, Python, web).
nodeTypes.capability: Something the project needs to be able to do; built or still needed.
nodeTypes.task: A unit of planned work with a time slot; completion is proof of work.
nodeTypes.commit: A git commit; carries its timestamp.
nodeTypes.agent: A software agent (chat, curator, worker) that can send and receive messages.
nodeTypes.question: An open question; may block other nodes.
nodeTypes.message: A message sent between agents through the connector.
nodeTypes.topic: A many-to-many channel agents subscribe to.

edgeTypes.dependsOn: Cannot be finished before the target.
edgeTypes.serves: A tool is used at a pipeline stage.
edgeTypes.ofSpecies: A dataset is of a species.
edgeTypes.completedBy: A task was finished by a commit (has an 'at' timestamp).
edgeTypes.deliveredIn: A capability ships in a pull request.
edgeTypes.needs: A stage needs a capability to move forward.
edgeTypes.analogOf: The tardigrade-side counterpart of a fly-side thing.
edgeTypes.blocks: A question blocks a node until it is answered.
edgeTypes.sentBy: A message was sent by an agent.
edgeTypes.sentTo: A message was delivered to an agent.
edgeTypes.postedIn: A message was posted to a topic.
edgeTypes.subscribes: An agent listens to a topic.
